description: This file defines the NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag class, which manages network traffic annotation metadata used for privacy and request tracking within Chromium. It includes predefined annotations, factory methods, and a custom hash function for annotations.

classes.name: NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag
classes.description: A class representing network traffic annotation metadata, including predefined static instances and methods for creating and hashing annotations.

methods.name: createComplete
methods.description: Factory method to create a NetworkTrafficAnnotationTag with a unique ID and protobuf string.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the annotation, used for runtime identification.

methods.name: iterativeHash
methods.description: Computes a custom hash of a string, matching the C++ recursive hash function, to produce consistent hashes across languages.
